reap50_resident_bench_2026_07_25.verdict: REAP-resident via --cpu-moe is NOT the decode-parity path as configured: decode 1.91 t/s is only ~1.35x streaming GLM and ~10x short of DSV4. Warm TTFT 1.56 s is the standout — meets the DSV4 <2 s bar and beats streaming GLM's 19 s, because prefix KV reuse leaves ~1 token of work. Cold prefill (4.37 t/s) is 5x WORSE than ds4 streaming. Probable causes: 139 GB > ~105 GiB usable page cache so ~25% of expert bytes still fault to disk with a scattered mmap pattern; all routed-expert math runs on Grace CPU cores; no expert-locality batching. Fidelity leg SKIPPED per pre-declared rule (only if perf pans out) — perf did not.
reap50_resident_bench_2026_07_25.possible_followups_not_run: -ncmoe N partial GPU offload (risk: non-reclaimable device-alloc, the attempt-1 OOM path); smaller REAP context; ds4-engine support for the REAP artifact (would get expert cache + batch dispatch, but REAP tensor layout is Q2_K not IQ2_XXS — down-kernel exists upstream)
